title: 1 Kings Bible Quiz - Chapter 15
description: Ten questions on 1 Kings 15: the kings Abijam and Asa in Judah, and Nadab and Baasha in Israel.

questions.text: How long did Abijam reign in Jerusalem?
questions.explanation: 1 Kings 15:2 says Abijam reigned three years in Jerusalem.

questions.text: In which matter alone did David turn away from what Yahweh commanded him?
questions.explanation: 1 Kings 15:5 says David did what was right all his life, except only in the matter of Uriah the Hittite.

answers.text: The matter of the census of Israel
The matter of Absalom his son
The matter of the ark of God
The matter of Uriah the Hittite

questions.text: How many years did Asa reign in Jerusalem?
questions.explanation: 1 Kings 15:10 says Asa reigned forty-one years in Jerusalem.

questions.text: Why did Asa remove Maacah his mother from being queen?
questions.explanation: 1 Kings 15:13 says he removed her because she had made an abominable image for an Asherah, which Asa cut down and burned at the brook Kidron.

answers.text: She had plotted to kill Asa
She had sent gold to the king of Syria
She had made an abominable image for an Asherah
She had married a foreign king

questions.text: What city did Baasha king of Israel build to block anyone going to or from Asa?
questions.explanation: 1 Kings 15:17 says Baasha went up against Judah and built Ramah, so no one could go out or come in to Asa king of Judah.

questions.text: To whom did Asa send the silver and gold from the treasuries?
questions.explanation: 1 Kings 15:18 says Asa sent it to Ben Hadad, the son of Tabrimmon, king of Syria, who lived at Damascus.

questions.text: What did Asa build with the stones and timber of Ramah?
questions.explanation: 1 Kings 15:22 says king Asa used the stones and timber of Ramah to build Geba of Benjamin, and Mizpah.

answers.text: An altar at the brook Kidron

questions.text: What illness did Asa have in his old age?
questions.explanation: 1 Kings 15:23 says that in the time of his old age he was diseased in his feet.

answers.text: He became blind in both eyes
He had leprosy on his skin
He was diseased in his feet

questions.text: Where did Baasha strike down Nadab?
questions.explanation: 1 Kings 15:27 says Baasha struck Nadab at Gibbethon, which belonged to the Philistines, while Nadab and all Israel were besieging it.

questions.text: When Baasha destroyed the house of Jeroboam, whose prophecy was fulfilled?
questions.explanation: 1 Kings 15:29 says it happened according to the saying of Yahweh, which he spoke by his servant Ahijah the Shilonite.
